blocks.text: Erwan Heussaff reflected on the bittersweet coincidence of his 9th wedding anniversary falling on the same day as his late father Louis’ memorial service, sharing how he has learned to embrace joy and grief at the same time. Erwan remembered his father by sharing a video of the latter’s speech during his wedding to actress-TV host Anne Curtis in 2017, through his Instagram page on Thursday, Nov. 12.
